programme.title: Mitchell Pehlke Lacrosse Show
programme.desc: Welcome to Episode 28 (Season 3) of the Mitchell Pehlke Lacrosse Show presented by Duke Cannon. In this episode, Mitch and the crew react to the results of the PLL Semifinals before looking ahead to the Denver Outlaws vs. Philadelphia Waterdogs in the 2026 PLL Championship. Later, they welcome Dan Kaplan of Inside Lacrosse to discuss the new Top 100 rankings for the Class of 2028, including No. 1 prospect Landen O'Neil. Stick around to watch the guys complete a PLL Immaculate Grid!
